title: MLINE-referenced simple LTYPE with ordered XDATA doubles

scope.source: Runtime-generated LTYPE and APPID records; no repository drawing fixture is used or added.
scope.cross_product: Both source encodings were exported to both output encodings.
scope.linetype: EditDash, two simple dash segments [1.0, -0.5], declared length 1.5, source flags 0, alignment 65.

authority.document: DXF Group Codes in Numerical Order Reference
authority.relevant_rule: XDATA groups 1040–1042 are double values; 1041 is a distance and 1042 is a scale factor. This receipt qualifies only the selected finite values and order.

proof.source: Physical source fields and fresh import verify one APPID followed by ordered typed groups 1040, 1041 and 1042. Import-time origin, raw/typed equality, the AppIdName role and APPID name lookup bind the provider.
proof.output: The staged output proof checks the exact code order and numeric values, APPID row common fields/flags/emitted owner and fresh typed readback of all three doubles.
proof.failure_retry: Removing the source APPID provider refuses export and preserves the destination sentinel; restoring it succeeds on the same adapter. A late APPID-name mutation also refuses atomically and succeeds after correction on the same adapter.

limits: This receipt qualifies one AC1027 simple-LTYPE application with exactly one APPID followed by the finite double sequence 1040=-12.5, 1041=2.75 and 1042=1.5. It does not qualify other numeric values/ranges, alternate orders, arbitrary mixed payload compositions, other XDATA types, nested-list compositions, 1003/1004/1005 dependency paths, APPID metadata, other LTYPE schemas or versions.
The receipt establishes transport only. It does not establish application-specific XDATA meaning, MLINE rendering, recursive document closure, or broader LTYPE provider support.
